headline: The PP-CC Government of the Canary Islands wants to require ten years of residence registration to buy a home in the islands
summary: The Canary Islands regional government's legislative proposal would require ten years of residence registration to buy a home. It would also limit buyers to two homes in different municipalities.
why: Property purchase rules affect housing demand and the investment case for real estate in Spain's Canary Islands.
